verdict.rationale: Bitwarden has no built-in natural-language interface. It ships an official first-party MCP server, which completed a hands-on initialize handshake, and a CLI whose `bw serve` mode exposes the vault as a local REST API. Together these let an external AI agent turn natural-language requests into vault operations, but only through a separate AI client. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which vault operations the MCP server exposes, and hands-on evidence of natural-language tasks actually being completed end-to-end.
